method: Static IL decoding, Ghidra decompilation/call references, Mach-O data recovery, authenticated AES-GCM, and compiled AppleScript decompilation; no specimen or embedded payload executed.
limits: Sandbox and MalwareBazaar pages were inaccessible; supplied provenance remains context, not proof.
Initial delivery and deployment authorization are unknown. Static attack attempts do not require successful network delivery.
AppleScript decompiler output can misreconstruct variables; call-site annotations and inspected arithmetic decoders retain execution evidence.

samples.tipping_evidence: Main installs disguised Windows Update autoruns and starts real keyboard/clipboard/screen/file collection, a TCP cmd bridge and HTTP command polling. It attempts Defender disable, an admin account and fodhelper hijacking; Microsoft version claims are unsigned.

traced_paths.Main RVA 0x2910: Run keys, Startup batch, onlogon task, BootExecute mutation, fodhelper DelegateExecute writes, hidden PowerShell Defender settings, net user/localgroup, debugger exit and NtSetInformationProcess class 29 with value 1. Starts collection and tasking threads.
traced_paths.KeyloggerModule.Start RVA 0x20cc: Installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL callback, buffers foreground-window-attributed key events; SendLoop RVA 0x22e8 appends the buffer to a local file and calls SendToC2.
traced_paths.PasswordRecoveryModule callback RVA 0x26: Builds Chrome/Edge Default profile paths; Login Data, Cookies and History are sent via SendFile RVA 0x37f0 (ReadAllBytes -> Base64 -> FILE record -> SendToC2).
traced_paths.Program.SendToC2 RVA 0x3c78: UTF8 input -> modulo 32-byte-key XOR loop -> Base64 -> EscapeDataString -> URL construction -> WebRequest.GetResponse. The same method receives keylog, clipboard, screenshot and file records.
traced_paths.Reverse-shell callback RVA 0x38bc: TcpClient(host,5555) -> StreamReader/Writer; hidden cmd.exe with redirected stdin/stdout; two delegate loops copy child output to peer and peer input to child.
traced_paths.Command executor callback RVA 0x3a24: GET command response -> read text -> cmd /c received text -> read stdout -> CMD_OUT record; download command instead sends a named local file.

limits: Namespace and user agent claim NanoCore; the simple implementation does not establish authentic upstream NanoCore lineage.
C2_DOMAIN already contains http://; HTTP concatenation duplicates the scheme and the TCP host contains the scheme. Actual delivery and a working reverse shell are unproven.
Microphone code attempts an AxHost recorder through PowerShell; working recording is unproven. No microphone-collection trait was added.
AMSI/ETW patch messages and ProcessHollowing status text are not implementations. Remote allocation/write/thread calls exist, but they are not process hollowing.
netsh wlan show profiles key=clear is attempted; this spelling does not prove that stored keys are returned. Existing trait accurately reports query references.

samples.tipping_evidence: Authenticated recovery reveals a run-only AppleScript that collects browser/session and Keychain secrets, phishes the login password, uploads archives and replaces wallet applications. Loader defeats inspection by corrupting key material.

traced_paths.constructor 0x100061a28: Opaque arithmetic and indexed branches hide real initialization before main; ordinary main dispatches into arithmetic decoys.
traced_paths.native key path 0x10006203f: Seed, self __TEXT,__text SHA256, environment/VM/debug checks and elapsed-time comparison select a 36-byte password. PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 uses 80258 iterations and a 32-byte salt.
traced_paths.chunk path 0x1000621ec: Custom table transforms Base64 characters; HKDF-SHA256 derives chunk nonces; 58 AES-GCM chunks all authenticate, 53 retained chunks concatenate to 262072 bytes. Native SHA256 integrity check independently matches recovered bytes.
traced_paths.AES-GCM helper 0x1000628a4: Frame-local lengths 32/12/16 and algorithm zero feed the indirect CCCryptorGCMOneshotDecrypt ABI; status is tested.
traced_paths.OSA helper 0x1000629bb: Hashed API dispatch loads Carbon/OpenScripting, builds a script descriptor, OSALoads the compiled bytes and OSAExecutes them. API entry INT3/JMP checks reject detours.
traced_paths.recovered script: Arithmetic character-list decoders resolve browser Login Data/Cookies/extension stores; hidden-answer password dialog and dscl authonly; security find-generic-password Chrome Safe Storage; Keychain copying; curl multipart POST /contact; wallet application deletion/download/extraction; LaunchDaemon plist and helper staging routines.

bootstrap.behavior: Authenticated separate compiled script sets _p0 through _p7 and returns zero; not a theft payload.

limits: Ad-hoc signing identifier com.oracle.authorization.8.2.154 is not Oracle provenance or a trusted signature.
Feed ClickFix/Foxveil label is consistent with recovered code, but initial lure and an actor are not proven.
Decoded routines establish static capabilities, not successful theft, persistence or wallet replacement on a victim.

samples.identification: yyzUSB resource-wrapper file infector and USB spreader
samples.tipping_evidence: Executable search results reach a host-wrapper routine that overwrites victims with a copy of itself, retaining original bytes in RCDATA; removable-drive copies and Autorun.inf are hidden. This is beyond an ordinary USB monitoring service.

traced_paths.0x46b1a0 -> 0x46d550: Enumerates *.exe and calls the wrapper. Copies self to a temporary path, reads the target file, stores its bytes using Begin/Update/EndUpdateResourceW, copies the temporary wrapper over the target, deletes the temporary file. The same temp path and CopyFileW IAT slot are bound in the new matcher.
traced_paths.static initializer 0x4ecdc0 -> 0x464540: If the current image has RCDATA resource 99, extracts its host to disk, CreateProcessW launches it, waits, and removes temporary host artifacts.
traced_paths.0x475410 -> 0x475840 / 0x454220: Loops drive letters, recognizes removable/USB drives, copies itself, writes Autorun.inf and marks artifacts hidden/system.
traced_paths.0x4647b0 / 0x4649c0 -> 0x464f30: Download URL processing resolves URLDownloadToFileW through Urlmon and launches the output with ShellExecuteW. Embedded example.com URLs are placeholders, not active C2 evidence.
traced_paths.0x471270 / 0x471a60 / 0x471d00: Opens PhysicalMemory with section access, adjusts its ACL when denied, resolves kernel exports/SSDT and patches/restores NtVdmControl for kernel-mediated operations. Security-product process lists and termination logic coexist; no successful AV bypass is claimed.

limits: No basis to assign Amadey, Remcos, HijackLoader or SmokeLoader solely from the collector filename. Elex detections are retained as existing yyzUSB carrier signatures.
The preserved legitimate host and helper PEs are not automatically convicted; new infection detections reject all three in isolation.
Modern Windows access controls may prevent the old PhysicalMemory/kernel technique. Its attempt and the file-replacement flow remain concrete.

changes.change: Preserved four old instruction alternatives and added the verified frame-local ABI layout; whole-container inline YARA examines both Mach-O slices.

changes.unsupported_claim: Ad-hoc signature, section size/entropy, a blob and a cache-flush import alone do not prove concealed execution or stealer family identity.
changes.change: Require already-supported key-sabotage behavior; correct the cache description and unsupported ATT&CK mappings. No matching batch or positive fixture coverage lost.

changes.unsupported_claim: Embedded installers and USB utilities can carry the entire original import/structural profile.
changes.change: Require the linked resource-wrapper overwrite mechanism as independent abuse evidence. Retained all original constituent observations.

changes.unsupported_claim: Literal section exclusions do not prove absence of a fully qualified Mach-O text section.
changes.change: Rename/re-describe only; matcher, scope, severity and exclusions preserved. Updated every YAML consumer.
Cover the inspected URI escaping and combined surveillance/XOR/HTTP request profile without asserting valid URLs or successful delivery.
Bind the temporary path and copy API across overwrite calls with an intervening RCDATA update; combine with self-path, resource APIs, embedded PE and file reads to describe infection.
